analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($856.49) vs SMA5 ($889.99)/SMA20 ($996.83)/SMA50 ($984.04): below short/mid-term, indicating weakening mid-term trend.
· Position vs SMA100 ($974.49)/SMA200 ($729.20): below long-term, potential for bearish shift.
· 52-week position (61.7%) + current price level is high relative to historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (39.2→34.7): entering oversold, strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-20.6540→-19.1003): remains negative, showing improvement but continuing bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $838.17): approaching lower band, increasing oversold pressure.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support line ($854.35): near current price, testing support.
· Swing resistance line ($1011.77): significant distance, difficult to break in short term.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: Higher Low not formed, continuing sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.17x): normal level, moderate confidence in movement.
· Current phase diagnosis: accumulation phase, need to confirm oversold exit and trend reversal before entry.
